text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] elevated 5xx (mostly 503) observed for hosted/infer-text in us-east-1 — error rate ~25% over 4m, p99 latency rising. paging oncall @maria @lin :rotating_light:

maria: ack. dashboards up. seeing backlog growth on runtime-us-east pool and a spike in kv_cache_evictions and large-allocation OOM warnings. any recent infra pushes?

lin: no infra pushes. early indicators point to very long prompts (history-heavy chat) and a sudden skew — few tenants hammering the same pool with multi-k token requests. these hold max_in_flight slots for a long time. runtime backlog -> enqueue_timeout -> 503s.

ajay: I can see retries blowing up at the edge too. clients retrying immediately is amplifying the load.

maria: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) lower max_in_flight for infer-text pool to 5 2) flip shedding strategy to 'shed_ratio=0.4' to aggressively drop expensive requests 3) enable circuit-breaker to reject requests > 8k tokens 4) create a vip-lane for paid flows and apply soft rate limits to non-vip 5) disable server-side streaming for trial/free routes 6) reduce enqueue_timeout to 100ms and request_timeout to 7s. objections?

kevin: +1. also suggest routing large-history sessions to a dedicated long-tail pool (long-tail-us-east) or to a quantized variant to reduce KV working set. ops, be ready to issue emergency quota exemptions for VIPs.

ajay: will apply router tweaks and edge limiter. need maria to push runtime config. i'll also reduce edge retries (max_retries=1, jitter=true).

maria: executing the runtime + edge changes now. audit commands below.

maria: ```bash
# runtime: lower concurrency & enable shedding/circuit breaker
curl -X PATCH 'https://console.internal/api/pools/infer-text-us-east/config' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"max_in_flight":5,"shedding":{"mode":"ratio","shed_ratio":0.4},"circuit_breaker":{"max_tokens":8000},"streaming_enabled":false,"enqueue_timeout_ms":100,"request_timeout_s":7}'

# edge: soft limit non-vip & reduce retries
curl -X POST 'https://edge.internal/api/rate-limiter/rules' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"match":"!tag:vip","limit_rps":8,"burst":12,"reason":"live-mitigation-us-east-229000"}'

curl -X PATCH 'https://edge.internal/api/retry-policy' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"max_retries":1,"base_backoff_ms":250,"jitter":true}'
```

deploy-bot: config cfg-229000-01 applied to pool/infer-text-us-east by maria — rolling to 50% of nodes.

lin: also changing routing: non-vip large-history -> long-tail-quant (weight 1.0) to reduce memory/KV footprints. ajay patched router.

ajay: router patch done. also lowered client-side retry header on the gateway for these routes.

ops-bot: emergency quota exemption template ready. pre-approved for flagged VIPs on request.

support-bot: tickets created for cust-88 and cust-145; both reporting timeouts. support and sales notified.

maria: monitoring metrics: 2m after config, backlog down ~65%, 5xx down to ~7% and trending down. p99 latency improving.

ajay: observe that placing long-history to long-tail-quant increases token cost but frees KV and reduces eviction churn. quality delta looks acceptable for non-vip.

lin: one wrinkle — kernel auto-select tripped to slower fallback on a subset of nodes after config. I'm rolling a quick check on kernel-selection metrics; will revert any kernel regressions.

maria: good catch. lin, if you find a kernel regression, add to followups.

kevin: handoff in ~20m. summary for next oncall:
- suspected cause: long-history sessions holding in-flight slots + KV cache thrash -> memory pressure -> max_in_flight saturation -> enqueue timeouts -> 503s
- live mitigations done: max_in_flight=5 for infer-text-us-east, shedding with shed_ratio=0.4, circuit-breaker for >8k tokens, disable streaming for trial routes, edge soft limit non-vip to 8 rps, reduce retries, route long-history to long-tail-quant, emergency quota process available for VIPs
- watchlist: middleware 5xx rate, runtime backlog, kv_cache_evictions, kernel-select fallbacks, per-customer error rates, model-quality signals for quantized path
- owners for followups: lin (kernel/select + kv root cause), ajay (router/prompt-length routing automation), maria (postmortem + customer comms)

maria: handing off to kevin. incident severity set P1, opening ticket INC-229000-01 for full RCA. leaving live mitigation thread closed, incident remains open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

kevin: taking over monitoring. I'll keep the mitigations for 30-45m and then plan a staged rollback if stable. paging rotation note: oncall -> kevin for next 8 hours.

ajay: metrics after 5m: backlog -78%, 5xx ~2.9%, avg retries down, kernel-select anomalies isolated to 2 nodes.

support-bot: sent customer note to cust-88 and cust-145 explaining mitigation and expected restoration timeline.

maria: thanks team. followups will be tracked in the postmortem. reaching out to account teams for VIPs that requested exemptions. end of thread.
